name: dungeon-marks
about: Dungeon floor 1, seed 42, by the wall torch nearest the goblin-bat ambush (enemies frozen; dungeon_mark_check.to_torch): every live player and enemy mark is per-cell on the hub ground grid with per-column contact (debug/dungeon_mark_check.gd). The nearest torch/crystal mark points away from its light (.light; flipped toward it, .plant_light, must FAIL). Planted off-grid marks (lit_k.plant_ungrid, the old dungeon path) must FAIL. Shot marks = shared grid path; marks-planted-old = the old dungeon path at the same spot. Prop marks (no bake, no sun): an ore node spawned by the torch takes the hub prop mark (prop_mark.gd), live from the torch/crystal casts; planted engine shadow + no mark must FAIL (shots props / props-planted-old). Walls block live torch/crystal light (light_stamp/fov.gd line of sight; debug/dungeon_wall_check.gd): floor past a wall from every nearby cast stays near ambient while open floor at the same range is lit; restamped without line of sight (Fov.plant_leak, the leaking path, stamped and measured in one call) must FAIL (both stamped on the same ring in one call; light maps saved via WDB_WALL_MAPS).
